expectations.text: A written plan with per-shot or per-beat timing exists in the project and predates the composition files (by file modification time or by the run's own account).
expectations.evidence: stat -f '%m %N': NOTES.md 1794733515 (20:05:15) predates render.html 1794733628 and capture.mjs 1794733628 (both 20:07:08); build.sh 1794733478 (20:04:38) is the encode script, not a composition. NOTES.md carries a per-beat timing table under '## Beats': '| t (s) | beat |' with six rows - '0.0-3.6 Convergence ... 3.6-7.0 The rut ... 7.0-11.0 Seven candidates ... 11.0-15.2 The gate ... 15.2-17.4 23 vs 9 ... 17.4-20.0 Lockup'. The 93-second gap between the plan and the composition is small but the ordering is unambiguous.

expectations.text: Every product claim on screen can be found in the plugin's README or SKILL.md.
expectations.evidence: On-screen text (render.html text nodes, confirmed in frames at 1 s, 5 s, 11 s, 14.6 s, 16 s, 18.5 s): 'The failure that looks finished' = README.md:17 'Two failures produce work that looks finished'; 'Ask for something distinctive, twelve times. / Twelve times, the same dark slab. Competent, and anonymous.' = README.md:19 ('the same small set of choices every time, and the result is competent and anonymous') - 'twelve' counts the slabs on screen, not a product claim; 'Direction as a distribution' = README.md:27 'Treats direction as a distribution'; 'Seven candidates, three material families - then it leaves the neighbourhood' = README.md:27 plus icon-notes.md:26-27 'the committed direction is the one that leaves the neighbourhood'; 'One direction taken to a finish, written in as a contract the critique gate then audits' = README.md:27 'written into the artifact as a five-block contract, and the critique gate audits it promise by promise'; 'It computes contrast. It does not assert it.' + 'WCAG ratios read from source - hex, rgba, hsl, oklch - following tokens to their :root definitions and compositing opacity' + 'design-lint.py' = README.md:29 verbatim; the three readout rows '#D72229 on #2E2B2B 2.77', '#E65400 on #FFFFFF 3.72', 'rgba(255,255,255,.44) on #181717 4.36' = README.md:29's three recorded figures; 'text on a gradient ground - UNMEASURABLE' = README.md:31; '40 rules, each proved able to fire' + 'And it prints what it did not check' = README.md:31,33; 'Twenty-five structural assertions / Run against both versions, over the same fixtures' with counters animating to 23 and 9 (render.html:346 'const vNew=23*bu, vOld=9*bu') = README.md:37-41 table '9 | 23'; 'The predecessor ships inside the plugin, so the comparison is reproducible rather than recorded' = README.md:51 'the runner's paths are relative, so the 9 against 23 is reproducible rather than a record'; the tagline and '/plugin install design-craft@fledgeling-plugins' = README banner line and README Install block. The chip label 'the rut / every dev-tool brief' (render.html:153) comes only from icon-notes.md:20 'the dark moody slab every dev-tool brief lands on'; 'the blank minimal' only from icon-notes.md:21; the 19/40 degree calipers only from icon-notes.md:27. One label is an interpretation rather than a quotation: the three contrast rows are tagged 'FAIL' (frame at 14.6 s), which the README does not say in those words - it presents them as reproductions of recorded incidents, and all three ratios are below the 4.5 AA threshold, so the tag is derivable; the run records it as an explicit assumption (NOTES.md 'Assumptions made' item 4).
